title: busbar.conformance.manifest/1
description: The single machine-readable source of truth for every busbar conformance/certification claim. GENERATED by `cargo xtask gate conformance-sync --write` from conformance/registry.toml + conformance/verdicts/*.json; never hand-edited. The README badge block and the website /certifications page are rendered FROM this file. A suite renders a public claim ONLY when status == "pass" and claim != null.

_generated.description: Provenance banner; the drift gate makes a hand-edit fatal.

release.description: The release this manifest is about, e.g. 1.6.0.

commit.description: The release commit the passing verdicts agree on (the shipping sha). A pass whose verdict commit is not this is downgraded to not-run(stale).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601; the latest verdict timestamp, so the render is reproducible from committed inputs.

tier.description: The CEILING a suite may claim (from the registry, never a run). certified: a third-party body issued a cert. conformant: passes an official/authoritative suite. spec-conformant: validated vs a published spec, no vendor cert program exists. capable: implements the mechanism, not externally validated. evidence-only: busbar supplies audit evidence, never its own cert.

suite.description: Stable suite id, matching the registry.

status.description: pass only if the verdict was armed, passed, and about the release commit.

claim.description: The rendered claim string, a pure function of (tier, status). null for anything that is not a green pass — null means NOTHING renders.

evidence.description: Link to the run/artifact that earned the pass.

expires.description: For certified entries: past expiry flips to not-run(expired).

reason.description: Why a non-pass suite is not-run/fail.
